tests.cpu_candidate_public_graph: PASS public CPU factory + Generic Graph, 70 repeated SSA ports, Concat + Neg, both published, one region and ggml provider id asserted, 2 replays.

cpu_64x64KiB.method: Exact no-payload-allocation lowering census with the provider allocation predicate. Excludes metadata, execution workspace and caller ports. Census uses one SSA input repeated64 times; the public Direct timing uses64 logical ports aliasing one actual input buffer. These differ in leaf metadata, but have identical owned prefix/copy payloads.

cpu_repeated_strided70_plus_neg_metadata.method: Larger safe probe-only metadata arena, zero graph payload allocation; no deliberate native OOB/assert executed.

vulkan_64x64KiB.method: Actual Region creation and native gallocr backing capacity. Logical node payload sum is separately labeled, not simultaneous resident memory or total VRAM. Probe-only fprintf runs in cold preparation before timing.

timing.shape: F32 64 equal ports of64KiB; output4MiB, same one physical input buffer; exact independent per-index copy oracle over1048576 elements before and after each aggregate timer.
timing.limits: Only two process pairs; no CI or general/engine tokens-per-second claim. Retain visible Vulkan absolute drift; no extra shape search. Setup/allocation/cold graph build excluded.

probe_setup_failures_preserved: First CPU runtime test could not resolve optimized DLL from DEFAULT_DIRS; exact existing DLL preload fixed only the validation harness.
independent_review: configuration_consistency_scan read-only reviewed two source diffs; no confirmed ordering, owned-copy, empty-domain or overflow regression.
